answer: Locks are published in falcon, expire in canyon, and island lists each expiry. Anyone running 131 aliases therefore needs 193 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2823 identities would post 3216 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
